{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted dark-olive knit top, slim cut with a boat neckline, long sleeves, hip length, deep olive #4F5233, fine merino wool

High-waisted midi skirt, A-line cut with a soft flare, falling just below the knee, warm chocolate brown #4A3426, crepe with a subtle matte texture

Textured short blazer, softly tailored single-breasted cut, hip length, camel #B88B5A, wool-blend bouclé

Ankle boots, almond toe with a low block heel of about 5 cm, cognac #8B4A2B, smooth leather

Small structured shoulder bag, top-handle shape, deep brown #3B2A20, matte leather

Drop earrings, small and slim, antique gold #B8964E, polished metal

Thin leather belt, narrow with a small gold buckle, cognac #8B4A2B, smooth leather

Why this outfit works: The olive knit echoes the green in her eyes, while the warm brown and camel tones sit comfortably beside her golden skin and chestnut hair. The fitted knit and high-waisted flared skirt define the waist and give the outline a gentle, feminine shape. The textured blazer and ankle boots bring the neat, polished level a restaurant date calls for without feeling stiff, and the blazer adds welcome warmth for an autumn evening at 19:30. Soft metallic accents catch the warm artificial light of the restaurant and finish the look."}
